title: What am I paying for
body: The app keeps freezing now and then. When I try to add tasks for the day they simply don’t get added and I also dislike the fact that you cannot edit yourself previous days after 12 hours
author: raylakek

title: It would’ve been amazing
body:
It would’ve been an fabulous app, helping millions: If it was free.
Believe me, the was these people market it as can be considered as a scam! 
Nowhere is written in the ad that the function that they’re marketing in the app, is paid.
I understand putting one, two functions paid. But the whole apps main functions for what the user has downloaded it (seeing the ad, or the app store bio of the app) is paid!!
stop this nonsense, and please, respect your users.
author: 말이 좀

title: по плачем
body:
